title: Hydrate operator relay policy from canonical 30900 relay-settings state
intended_behavior: Backend runtime relay policy hydrates from the latest service-signed kind 30900 relay-settings state after restart.
The Settings operator relay policy form hydrates from canonical relay-settings state instead of relying only on discovery payload or local browser relay overrides.
Relay-settings hydration uses scoped Nostr subscriptions with EOSE for historical catch-up and keeps subscriptions open for realtime convergence.
Hydration validates inbound events, trusted service author, content schema, required tags, and parameterized replaceable semantics by pubkey plus d tag.
protocol_constraints: No new relay-routing kinds are introduced.
ContextVM acknowledgments are not durable truth; canonical 30900 state is the relay policy read model.
NIP-86 remains optional relay-owner HTTP administration and is represented in policy state only for configured Bahia-owned or Bahia-authorized targets.
No polling or timeout-based completion is used for relay-settings state delivery.
